title: scabiosa columbaria var. patens
intro: Scabiosa columbaria var. patens, commonly known as Pincushion Scabious, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the honeysuckle family (Caprifoliaceae). Pincushion Scabious is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, thanks to its sedative and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as modulating the nervous system and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Pincushion Scabious also include its potential to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and support immune function.
